svg.aria-label: Three PRs move thirteen functions out of TorchSpyreModelRunner into four shared modules: block_compile.py and pool/warmup.py (#1320), pool/encoder_grid.py (#1319) and kv_cache_setup.py (#1317). V1 runner methods call them today; the planned V2 load, compile, warmup, pooling runner, attention-group and KV-cache components will call the same functions. The shared modules import only lower layers; V2 still imports four V1 module-level helpers until the flip.
